sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Board is reset. Now try filling with bottom palette order: R, p, N, O, M, b, Y
# Palette positions (from the image): R=col10, p=col17, N=col25, O=col33, M=col40, b=col47, Y=col55
# Slots: upper(22, 28, 40), lower(22, 28, 34, 40)

# Get palette positions from segmentation
seg = current_frame.segmentation
lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

# Find palette colors
palette_colors = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 16:  # 4x4 squares in palette
        b = n['boundary']
        r = b[0][0]
        if r >= 55:  # bottom palette
            c = b[0][1]
            palette_colors.append((n['color'], r, c))

palette_colors.sort(key=lambda x: x[2])  # sort by column
print("Palette colors (left to right):", [(c, col) for c, r, col in palette_colors])

# Fill order: bottom palette left-to-right
# R, p, N, O, M, b, Y
fill_actions = []
for i, (color, pr, pc) in enumerate(palette_colors):
    fill_actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 57, 'col': pc})  # select color
    if i < 3:  # upper box slots
        slot_col = [22, 28, 40][i]
        fill_actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 36, 'col': slot_col})
    else:  # lower box slots
        slot_col = [22, 28, 34, 40][i - 3]
        fill_actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 36, 'col': slot_col})

print("Fill sequence:", fill_actions)
action(fill_actions)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
